dialogue_history.speaker: Scene Master
dialogue_history.message:
SCENARIO START: The Unannounced Indefinite Guests
Details: The husband's extended family arrives unannounced for a two-week stay in the couple's urban apartment, expecting full hosting and home-cooked meals despite both partners working full-time.

dialogue_history.speaker: Agent A
dialogue_history.message: <InternalThought>Perception: Perceiving partner's initial action. | Emotion: 0.00 Anger, 0.50 Safety | Motive: Protect self | Policy: 0.57 Reactive | Action: REPAIR</InternalThought>\nOkay, I'll make some space in the kitchen for them to set up their own meals and we can start planning some adjustments to accommodate their extended family's needs, but let's keep things straightforward so everyone knows what to expect.
